items.title: Critical Dell Storage Manager Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Compromise System

items.title: Hackers Exploiting Microsoft WSUS Vulnerability In The Wild – 2800 Instances Exposed Online
items.description: Hackers are actively exploiting a critical flaw in Microsoft’s Windows Server Update Services (WSUS), with security researchers reporting widespread attempts in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-59287, allows remote code execution on unpatched WSUS servers, potentially granting attackers full control over enterprise networks. items.title: New EDR-Redir Tool Breaks EDR Exploiting Bind Filter and Cloud Filter Driver
items.description: A new tool called EDR-Redir has emerged, allowing attackers to redirect or isolate the executable folders of popular Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions. Demonstrated by cybersecurity researcher TwoSevenOneT, the technique leverages Windows’ Bind Filter driver (bindflt.sys) and Cloud Filter driver (cldflt.sys) to undermine EDR protections without requiring kernel-level access. items.title: New CoPhish Attack Exploits Copilot Studio to Exfiltrate OAuth Tokens
items.description: A sophisticated phishing technique called CoPhish exploits Microsoft Copilot Studio to trick users into granting attackers unauthorized access to their Microsoft Entra ID accounts.
